hook.text: Hush Puppies shoes were dead in 1994. By 1996, every hip kid in New York wore them. What happened?

buildup.text: Malcolm Gladwell called it the tipping point—the moment a small trend explodes into a phenomenon.

discovery.text: Three factors matter: connectors who know everyone, mavens who know everything, and salesmen who persuade.

twist.text: Critics argue Gladwell oversimplified. Duncan Watts showed random people can trigger tipping points too.

climax.text: The truth is messier. Virality needs the right content in the right network at the right moment.

punchline.text: Everything tips. Predicting when is the hard part.

quiz.question: Who popularized the concept of 'the tipping point'?
